top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(7)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Director did not have a current transportation training.

top_violation_types.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care (26 TAC §746.801(11))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection available.

top_violation_types.title: Types of Vehicles Used to Transport Children - Be Maintained Safely (26 TAC §746.5603(c))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One vehicle was observed to have expired liability insurance required to operate a driving vehicle required by Department of motor vehicles for the state of Texas.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's file was missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's immunization record was observed incomplete.

top_violation_types.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records (26 TAC §746.801(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Playground check sheets were not available.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(1)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The director's files is incomplete and does not have proof of orientation, DL/ID, pre-affidavit, nor an signed affidavit.

top_violation_types.title: Measurement of Use Zone for Rotating and Rocking Equipment (Standing or Riding) (26 TAC §746.4813(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The rotating equipment did not have a seven foot use zone.
